G1804.b:

a: Biblico-Theological Lexicon of N.T. Greek, by H. Cremer. Third English Edition, with Supplement. T. & T. Clark, 1886

G1806.b:
⟪ἐξ-άγω⟫
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨יָצָא⁩ hi. ;] ⟪to lead out⟫: c. acc, ⟦Mark 15:20|Mk 15:20⟧, ⟦John 10:3|Jo 10:3⟧, ⟦Acts 5:19|Ac 5:19⟧ ⟦Acts 7:36|7:36⟧ ⟦Acts 16:37|16:37⟧, ⟦Acts 16:39|39⟧; seq. ἔξω, ⟦Luke 24:50|Lk 24:50⟧; ἐκ, ⟦Acts 7:40|Ac 7:40⟧ ⟦Acts 12:17|12:17⟧ ⟦Acts 13:17|13:17⟧, ⟦Hebrews 8:9|He 8:9⟧; εἰς, ⟦Acts 21:38|Ac 21:38⟧.†

G1807.b:
⟪ἐξ-αιρέω -ῶ⟫
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨נָצַל⁩ hi. ;] ⟪to take out⟫: c. acc, ὀφθαλμόν, ⟦Matthew 5:29|Mt 5:29⟧ ⟦Matthew 18:9|18:9⟧; mid.

Notes on the Translation of the N.T., by F. Field, Camb., 1899

G1811.b:
† ⟪ἐξ-ακολουθέω⟫, -ῶ
[in LXX ⟦Amos 2:4|Am 2:4⟧, ⟦Jeremiah 2:2|Je 2:2⟧ (⁨אַחַר⁩ ⁨הָלַךְ⁩), ⟦Isaiah 56:11|Is 56:11⟧ (⁨פָּנָה⁩), ⟦Job 31:9|Jb 31:9⟧ (⁨פָּתָה⁩ ni.), Si 5:2, ⟦Daniel 3:1|Da LXX TH 3:(41)⟧* ;] ⟪to follow, follow up⟫ (in various senses): metaph., ⟦2 Peter 1:16|II Pe 1:16⟧ ⟦2 Peter 2:2|2:2⟧ ,⟦2 Peter 2:15|15⟧ †

G1813.b:
⟪ἐξ-αλείφω⟫
[in LXX for ⁨טוּחַ⁩, ⟦Leviticus 14:42|Le 14:42⟧, al.; metaph., ⁨מָחָה⁩, ⁨שָׁחַת⁩, etc. ;]

G1815.b:

a: Biblico-Theological Lexicon of N.T. Greek, by H. Cremer. Third English Edition, with Supplement. T. & T. Clark, 1886

G1816.b:
⟪ἐξ-ανα-τέλλω⟫
[in LXX: ⟦Genesis 2:9|Ge 2:9⟧, ⟦Psalms 104:14|Ps 103(104):14⟧ ⟦Psalms 132:17|Ps 131(132):17⟧ ⟦Psalms 147:8|Ps 146(147):8⟧ (⁨צָמַח⁩ hi.); ⟦Psalms 112:4|Ps 111(112):4⟧ (⁨זָרַח⁩) * ;]

G1817.b:
